chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام disliked that a fasting person perform cupping, out of fear that he might faint and then break his fast.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.يَكْرَهُ: he disliked; indicates karahah rather than prohibition
key_terms.يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ: he might faint or lose consciousness

ai.seo_question: Did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام dislike cupping for a person who is fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام disliked cupping for a fasting person because it could cause him to faint. The concern is not that cupping itself necessarily invalidates the fast, but that it may lead to a condition resulting in breaking the fast.
